name_zh: 生物技术/医疗外交/古巴模式：医疗生态链主与全球南方健康
name_en: Biotech/Medical Diplomacy/Cuban Model: Medical Ecosystem Chain-Master & Global South Health
description_zh: 古巴生物技术产业 1980s 起步(干扰素/脑膜炎B疫苗/肺癌疫苗CIMAvax/Heberprot-P糖尿病足)/生物技术西方/出口 50+ 国/新冠疫苗(阿卜达拉/索贝拉纳)/医疗外交(5万+医生派驻 60+ 国)。核心模式：国家主导研发/封闭创新/南南合作/专利池/技术转让/人才留存。体现 M163 医疗生态链主 — 以"国家主导研发+封闭创新生态+南南技术转让+医生外交网络"四位一体，在封锁/资源匮乏/人才外流三重约束下构建全球南方医疗生态链主。
description_en: Cuban biotech industry 1980s start (interferon/meningitis B vaccine/lung cancer vaccine CIMAvax/Heberprot-P diabetic foot)/biotech Western/exports 50+ countries/COVID vaccines (Abdala/Soberana)/medical diplomacy (50k+ doctors deployed 60+ countries). Core model: state-led R&D/closed innovation/South-South cooperation/patent pools/tech transfer/talent retention. Exemplifies M163 Medical Ecosystem Chain-Master — quaternity of 'state-led R&D + closed innovation ecosystem + South-South tech transfer + doctor diplomacy network' building Global South medical ecosystem chain-master amid blockade/resource scarcity/brain drain triple constraints.
reason_zh: 古巴生物技术非单纯产业，而是"国家研发+封闭创新+南南合作+医生外交"四位一体生存战略。美封锁迫使自主研发，苏联解体迫使出口创汇，人才外流迫使国内留存机制。M163 区隔于 M158 通才整合(农牧+科技)、M168 资源诅咒(石油)、M192 游击解放(马谢尔)，核心在于"封锁倒逼自主+资源匮乏倒逼创新+南南合作倒逼开放"的封锁下创新范式。
reason_en: Cuban biotech not mere industry but 'state R&D + closed innovation + South-South coop + doctor diplomacy' quaternity survival strategy. US blockade forced autonomous R&D, USSR collapse forced export revenue, brain drain forced retention mechanisms. M163 distinct from M158 Polymath Integration (agri+tech), M168 Resource Curse (oil), M192 Guerrilla Liberation (Machel), core: 'blockade forces autonomy + scarcity forces innovation + South-South forces openness' innovation-under-blockade paradigm.

疫苗主权与出口创汇：脑膜炎B(世界首创)/肺癌CIMAvax/Heberprot-P/新冠阿卜达拉/索贝拉纳/出口 50+ 国/创汇 $10 亿+/年

Vaccine sovereignty & export revenue: Meningitis B (world first)/lung cancer CIMAvax/Heberprot-P/COVID Abdala/Soberana/exports 50+ countries/revenue $1B+/yr

Doctor diplomacy network & health security: 50k+ doctors/60+ countries/Ebola/COVID/hurricanes/earthquakes/humanitarian aid/soft power/Cuban brand/Global South health public good

Talent retention & intergenerational transmission: scientists high pay/housing/children education/international conferences/honors/young scientists/Cuban Academy of Sciences/free education/zero-tuition PhDs
expected_zh: 以"国家研发+封闭创新+南南转让+医生外交"四位一体，在美封锁/资源匮乏/人才外流三重约束下构建全球南方医疗生态链主，为发展中国家自主创新提供封锁下生存范式。
